firstPlayerRule: The animal furthest left on the Initiative track makes the first action-pawn placement. Set the initial track in reverse Food Chain order: insects, arachnids, amphibians, birds, reptiles, then mammals, using only the animals in play.
clarifications: Planning proceeds from left to right along the Initiative track. Action resolution later follows the action display from top to bottom and left to right.
